How buying on AutoVista works

No haggling marathons, no mystery fees. The price you see is checked against the market, and most of the paperwork happens before you set foot in the showroom.

1

Compare real prices

Filter 48,000+ listings and spot Great Deals instantly — every price is rated against similar cars sold within 100 miles in the last 45 days.

2

Reserve & test drive

Hold a car for 48 hours with one tap, book a test drive at the dealer, or have the car brought to your home or office.

3

Finance & drive away

Get a real finance quote in minutes, e-sign the paperwork, and drive away — with a 7-day money-back promise on certified cars.
